_comment: focus = inspection focus that reveals it. obviousness 1=subtle 2=clear 3=unmissable. time = seconds of focus needed.

anomalies.label: Extra finger
anomalies.description: The right hand has six fingers. Not a scar or a glove. Six.
anomalies.hint: Zoom on the hands. Count them.

anomalies.label: Misaligned eyes
anomalies.description: The eyes sit at slightly different heights and look two degrees apart.
anomalies.hint: Zoom on the eyes when they are still.

anomalies.label: Never blinks
anomalies.description: You watched for a long time. The eyes never closed.
anomalies.hint: Hold on the eyes. Humans blink. Watch.

anomalies.label: Blinking too fast
anomalies.description: It blinks in rapid bursts, like a camera shutter.
anomalies.hint: Hold on the eyes for a few seconds.

anomalies.label: Too-wide smile
anomalies.description: The smile reaches past the corners of the face, into the jaw.
anomalies.hint: Look at the mouth while it is smiling.

anomalies.label: Impossible neck
anomalies.description: The head turns further than a neck allows, and settles wrong.
anomalies.hint: Watch the neck while the customer turns to look at you.

anomalies.label: No reflection
anomalies.description: The glass behind the customer throws back the aisle. Nothing else.
anomalies.hint: Use the store windows or the fridges. Reflections are honest.

anomalies.label: Wrong shadow
anomalies.description: The shadow is half a second behind the body. It does not always match it.
anomalies.hint: Look at the floor while the customer moves.

anomalies.label: Disproportionate hands
anomalies.description: The hands are too long. The fingers reach the wrist of the other arm.
anomalies.hint: Zoom on the hands.

anomalies.label: Face changes in the flicker
anomalies.description: For one frame, under the failing light, the face was not this face.
anomalies.hint: Use the flickering lights. Look at the face when it stutters.

anomalies.label: Eyes move alone
anomalies.description: The eyes follow you while the head stays perfectly still.
anomalies.hint: Step sideways while holding focus on the face.

anomalies.label: Too many teeth
anomalies.description: Every tooth is identical, and there are more of them than there should be.
anomalies.hint: Zoom on the mouth while the customer speaks.

anomalies.label: Frozen expression
anomalies.description: Nothing on that face has moved. Not once, through all of it.
anomalies.hint: Hold on the face through a whole conversation.

anomalies.label: Physically still
anomalies.description: Chest, shoulders, hands, all of it. Nothing is breathing.
anomalies.hint: Watch the posture. Breathing is the tell.

anomalies.label: Repeats the same line
anomalies.description: Ask it anything. It answers with the same sentence, in the same cadence.
anomalies.hint: Talk to them more than once. Listen to the rhythm.

anomalies.label: Answers the wrong question
anomalies.description: You asked about the weather. It answered about the back of your head.
anomalies.hint: Use the dialogue options. Something should not line up.

anomalies.label: Will not stop staring
anomalies.description: It has not looked away from you since it entered. Not once.
anomalies.hint: Let it wait. Watch where the head points.

anomalies.label: Freezes mid-motion
anomalies.description: It stopped with one hand still lifted, and stayed exactly there.
anomalies.hint: Watch them for a while without saying anything.

anomalies.label: Wrong breathing
anomalies.description: The breathing does not come from a chest. It comes from everywhere in the aisle.
anomalies.hint: Listen. Stand close and let the store go quiet.

anomalies.label: Knows too much
anomalies.description: It mentioned the stockroom door. The one you have never opened tonight.
anomalies.hint: Ask questions that a stranger could not answer.

anomalies.label: Impossible date
anomalies.description: The expiry date is next century. Printed properly. Same ink as the rest.
anomalies.hint: Inspect items on the belt before scanning them.

anomalies.label: Barcode scans wrong
anomalies.description: The scanner read the barcode and the register printed a word instead of a price.
anomalies.hint: Scan everything. Read what the register says.

anomalies.label: Impossible card
anomalies.description: The card bears a name that has no vowels and a date that has already passed.
anomalies.hint: Look at the card when they pay.

anomalies.label: Message on receipt
anomalies.description: Printed under the total: THANK YOU FOR LETTING ME.
anomalies.hint: Check the receipt after approving.

anomalies.label: Item nobody placed
anomalies.description: There is one more item on the belt than they carried, and it is not from the store.
anomalies.hint: Count what was in their basket against what is on the belt.

anomalies.label: Wrong on camera
anomalies.description: On the security feed the customer is a column of standing dark, taller than the aisle.
anomalies.hint: Watch the security monitor behind the register.

harmless_traits.label: Finger tattoos
harmless_traits.text: Ink across the knuckles. It spells a name.

harmless_traits.label: Old scar
harmless_traits.text: A scar through the eyebrow. Healed years ago.

harmless_traits.label: Lazy eye
harmless_traits.text: One eye drifts when they are tired. That happens to people.

harmless_traits.label: Glass eye
harmless_traits.text: A prosthetic. It does not move. Prosthetics do not.

harmless_traits.label: Shivering
harmless_traits.text: They are cold. It is the freezer aisle.

harmless_traits.label: Nervous hands
harmless_traits.text: Rings, tapping, fidgeting. People do that.

harmless_traits.label: Bandaged hand
harmless_traits.text: A work injury. Two fingers are wrapped out of sight.

harmless_traits.label: Hearing aid
harmless_traits.text: They lean in. They misheard your question.

harmless_traits.label: No eyebrows
harmless_traits.text: No brows, no lashes. Medical, or just how they are.

harmless_traits.label: Eye twitch
harmless_traits.text: A nervous tic. It repeats, and it is harmless.
